name: Europe
heroIntro: Europe has the most established EPR landscape in the world, and it's about to get more demanding. Between national packaging, WEEE and battery schemes in individual member states and the incoming EU wide Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation, Ecoveritas already helps businesses stay ahead on both fronts.
ctaTitle: Selling into Europe? Let's plan for PPWR and beyond, together.
ctaText: Tell us which markets you sell into. We'll come back with a clear plan for your EU-wide and country-specific obligations.
seoDescription: National packaging, WEEE and battery EPR in every EU market, with PPWR on top. Explore the map, see what applies in each country, and plan both layers with one team.
